items.title: UP ordinance paves way to defer panchayat polls by 6 mths
points: The Uttar Pradesh cabinet on Wednesday promulgated an ordinance to give a six-month extension to panchayat administrators, allowing the government to defer holding elections to the panchayat bodies in the state.
The ordinance, proposing an amendment to a sub-section of Section 12 of the Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act,1947, would be sent to the Jan Bhavan for promulgation by the governor soon, Khanna said.
Since the state legislature is not in session and immediate action is required, the government decided to promulgate the ordinance under Article 213 of the Constitution, he added.

items.title: UP seat-sharing talks with Cong to be held after Nov 20: SP chief
points: Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav on Wednesday said that seat-sharing negotiations with the Congress for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections were on track and will begin after Ekadashi, which falls on November 20.
Uttar Pradesh has 403 assembly seats and is expected to witness a major contest between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the SP in the upcoming elections.
On Tuesday, SP lawmaker Rajeev Rai said his party and the Congress will constitute committees to discuss seat-sharing, with proposed committee meetings scheduled from November 23-25.
The confirmation comes after Yadav stated recently at the HT Leadership Summit that the Congress was seeking 181 seats in an alliance for the 403-member assembly.
The two parties, key partners in the Opposition INDIA bloc, contested the 2024 Lok Sabha elections together in UP, with the SP winning 37 seats and the Congress securing six seats.

items.title: DGCA proposes separate registration system for prototype, production aircraft
points: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has proposed a separate registration mechanism for aircraft undergoing production and prototype testing, allowing manufacturers to obtain dedicated registration marks for test flights without entering the…

items.title: Shipping industry urges governments to agree on global GHG regulations to provide regulatory certainty and incentivize maritime decarbonization
points: The regulatory framework must also meaningfully support a safe energy transition through solutions which are data-driven and fuel and technology neutral.

A coordinated global approach at IMO must lead to the avoidance of regulatory fragmentation or regional or national measures which result in duplication of compliance requirements for ships or multiple charges for the same GHG emissions.

'If oppn stops participating, Indian democracy would end': Rahul Gandhi in US rules out poll boycott
points: During his address at the University of Chicago, Rahul Gandhi emphasized the opposition's strong dedication to engaging in elections and dismissed the idea of a boycott, asserting it would significantly harm India's democratic integrity.

He elaborated on troubling aspects of Indian democracy, pointed out escalating issues within the Election Commission, and highlighted serious economic challenges, like high unemployment and education deficits.

items.title: 'The sky will not fall': SC denies to stay Azam bail
points: Azam Khan was released from Dasna jail after the Allahabad high court granted him interim bail.
The Enforcement Directorate failed to provide written grounds for his arrest, which led to the court's decision.

items.title: 'Defence, security ties key': Jaishankar ahead of India-Japan 2+2 dialogue
points: External affairs minister S Jaishankar and defence minister Rajnath Singh are in Japan for the 4th 2+2 dialogue.

items.title: CJI averts 'potential religious row', pulls cases from SC judge
points: CJI Surya Kant withdrew two cases from the bench headed by Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah, averting a potential religious controversy.

items.title: Can an Italian raise slogans against govt while in India on visa? SC to hear PIL
points: The Supreme Court has agreed to consider a petition concerning Italian Giacomo Filibeck's comments during a recent conference in Hyderabad.
The petition claims that he breached visa terms by supporting local political matters.

items.title: US court to Delhi courts: Help serve summons to RAW ex-chief, Doval
points: The order was issued in a civil lawsuit filed by Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, founder of pro-Khalistan outfit Sikhs for Justice (SFJ).

items.title: 35 yrs on, a landmark moment: Forces kill Kashmir's last active local terrorist
points: Security forces gunned down Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Mohammad Lateef Bhat during a shootout outside a mosque in Kulgam.
This incident concluded a weeklong operation to find him after the attack on a CRPF picket in Kulgam on November 11.

items.title: Keralam ministers question CM's key calls at cabinet meet
points: Keralam CM V D Satheesan encountered questions regarding key decisions during the cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
Ministers raised concerns about appointments and representation, leading to discussions for nearly two-and-a-half hours.

items.title: Govt hospitals to hike Ayushman packages from 23 to 112
points: Patients under Ayushman Bharat will soon have access to a broader range of medical treatments and surgical procedures.
The government plans to expand packages from 23 to 112, covering various health conditions and treatments.
New packages will include procedures like hysterectomy, circumcision, and diabetic-related complications.
Community health centres and sub-divisional hospitals will provide these services, depending on available infrastructure and staff.

items.title: SC starts contempt case against lawyer for remarks against CJI
points: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta, Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana directed the lawyer to file his response by January 8 and also ordered him to appear personally before it on the next date of hearing on January 20.
